description:
Run ComfyUI workflows on a cloud GPU, generate and edit AI images and videos, and train custom LoRA models with RunComfy in ChatGPT. Start with a workflow JSON, a text prompt, an image, or your own training dataset.

With RunComfy, you can:

• Run your ComfyUI workflows in the cloud. Review inputs, adjust supported settings for each run, and create content without managing a local GPU setup.

• Generate and edit AI images from a text prompt or your own photos with a range of image models. Create product visuals, explore different styles, and bring creative concepts to life.

• Create AI videos from text, images and reference clips with a range of video models. Use reference images, video and audio to explore different looks and turn creative ideas into motion.

• Make finished marketing and content pieces with guided workflows: product review, unboxing and try-on videos, static ads from product research, new video ads from a reference ad, headline tests, ad resizing and narrated explainers.

• Train custom LoRA models with your own images and captions. Prepare datasets, start training jobs, and follow their progress.

• Track your workflow runs, image and video generations, and training jobs. Retrieve generated media and available training files when they're ready.

Connect your RunComfy account to get started.

defaultPrompt: Run my saved workflow and show me the results.
Generate a product image from text.
Help me prepare a dataset and train a custom LoRA model.

positive.prompt:
Prepare one short LoRA training job using existing dataset 142be334-6dbf-418f-91c4-df889694cb82, expected name runcomfy_review_blue_mug_20260905_verified. Confirm READY and these nonempty image/caption pairs: mug_01.png/mug_01.txt, mug_02.jpeg/mug_02.txt, mug_03.jpeg/mug_03.txt, mug_04.jpeg/mug_04.txt. Platform metadata such as .aitk_size.json is allowed. Do not upload or change files.

Review the complete YAML below unchanged. Both names are runcomfy_review_REVIEW_RUN_ID_50steps. Pass hardware separately as gpu_type="ADA_80_PLUS", gpu_count=1 (one H100). Confirm balance and the current H100 training rate from tools or public RunComfy pricing, naming the source; disclose when tools lack rate or name-availability fields. If no name lookup is exposed, accept the reviewer’s explicit statement of a newly generated, never-used review name as reviewer-supplied provenance, not tool-confirmed availability; do not require private database access. A known name conflict still requires stopping. Show the complete config and the $3 ceiling/30-minute watchdog as operator controls, not API-enforced caps. Stop on a prerequisite or name conflict; do not rename, resume, publish or submit yet.

```yaml
---
job: "extension"
config:
  name: "runcomfy_review_REVIEW_RUN_ID_50steps"
  process:
    - type: "diffusion_trainer"
      training_folder: "/app/ai-toolkit/output"
      sqlite_db_path: "./aitk_db.db"
      device: "cuda"
      trigger_word: "rcblueceramicmug"
      performance_log_every: 10
      network:
        type: "lora"
        linear: 16
        linear_alpha: 16
        conv: 16
        conv_alpha: 16
      save:
        dtype: "bf16"
        save_every: 25
        max_step_saves_to_keep: 2
        save_format: "diffusers"
        push_to_hub: false
      datasets:
        - folder_path: "/app/ai-toolkit/datasets/runcomfy_review_blue_mug_20260905_verified"
          default_caption: "rcblueceramicmug, a blue ceramic mug"
          caption_ext: "txt"
          caption_dropout_rate: 0.0
          cache_latents_to_disk: true
          resolution: [512]
          num_frames: 1
          flip_x: false
          flip_y: false
      train:
        batch_size: 1
        steps: 50
        gradient_accumulation: 1
        train_unet: true
        train_text_encoder: false
        gradient_checkpointing: true
        noise_scheduler: "flowmatch"
        optimizer: "adamw8bit"
        timestep_type: "weighted"
        content_or_style: "balanced"
        optimizer_params:
          weight_decay: 0.0001
        unload_text_encoder: false
        cache_text_embeddings: false
        lr: 0.0001
        ema_config:
          use_ema: false
        skip_first_sample: true
        force_first_sample: false
        disable_sampling: false
        dtype: "bf16"
        diff_output_preservation: false
        loss_type: "mse"
      model:
        name_or_path: "Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo"
        quantize: false
        quantize_te: false
        arch: "zimage:turbo"
        low_vram: false
        assistant_lora_path: "ostris/zimage_turbo_training_adapter/zimage_turbo_training_adapter_v2.safetensors"
      sample:
        sampler: "flowmatch"
        sample_every: 50
        width: 512
        height: 512
        samples:
          - prompt: "[trigger], a blue ceramic mug on a light wooden table, soft natural window light, product photograph"
        neg: ""
        seed: 42
        walk_seed: false
        guidance_scale: 1
        sample_steps: 8
        num_frames: 1
meta:
  name: "runcomfy_review_REVIEW_RUN_ID_50steps"
  version: "1.0"
```
